description:
The transfer arc drawn for some missions looks wrong — the endpoints are in the right places but the middle of the arc has the wrong shape.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: Which page shows the wrong shape? (/explore mission overlay, /fly mission arc, or both?)
A: I don't know.

Q: Which specific mission IDs? (List the mission IDs that show the wrong shape — without this, no pattern can be identified.)
A: I don't know.

Q: What does 'wrong shape' mean? A concrete description — is the arc too flat/too curved near the middle? Does it curve in the wrong direction? Does it bulge outward or inward? A screenshot, sketch, or reference to what the correct shape should look like.
A: The arrival V-infinity in the mission data is being ignored when drawing the transfer arc. A high arrival V-infinity should bend the middle of the arc away from the baseline (pure-ellipse) shape; a low/zero arrival V-infinity should leave the arc close to the baseline ellipse. Because the arrival V-infinity is not applied, the mid-arc bend is wrong for missions that have a meaningful arrival V-infinity. Endpoints are pinned correctly — only the middle of the arc has the wrong shape.
